row.name: interests_scope_columns
row.value:
(
        ("scope" = 'departure'
          and "trip_id" is not null
          and "course_id" is null
          and "interest" is null
          and "preferred_date" is null
          and "alternate_date" is null
          and "date_flexible" = false
          and "experience_level" is null
          and "timing" is null
          and "message" is null
          and "available_from" is null
          and "available_until" is null)
        or ("scope" = 'date'
          and "trip_id" is null
          and ("course_id" is not null or length(btrim(coalesce("interest", ''))) > 0)
          and "available_from" is null
          and "available_until" is null)
        or ("scope" = 'anytime'
          and "trip_id" is null
          and "course_id" is null
          and "interest" is null
          and "preferred_date" is null
          and "alternate_date" is null
          and "date_flexible" = false
          and "experience_level" is null
          and "timing" is null
          and "message" is null
          and ("available_from" is null
            or "available_until" is null
            or "available_from" <= "available_until"))
      )

row.name: interests_has_a_person
row.value: "scope" = 'date' or "person_id" is not null or "parent_interest_id" is not null

row.name: interests_offer_is_a_departure
row.value: "scope" = 'departure' or ("offered_at" is null and "promo_id" is null)

row.name: interests_emailed_after_offer
row.value: "emailed_at" is null or "offered_at" is not null

row.name: interests_party_size_range
row.value: ("party_size" is not null or "scope" <> 'departure') and ("party_size" is null or "party_size" between 1 and 20)
